verdict.rationale: No evidence states a no-training policy or a training opt-out for the hosted API. Users can still keep documents away from Datalab by running the models on their own infrastructure: on-prem under an Enterprise contract, aimed at teams that 'require data privacy', or the free open-source Marker/Surya/Chandra. The Team plan also includes a DPA, which may contractually limit data use, though its terms aren't shown. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that customer data is not used for model training, a documented opt-out control for the hosted service, DPA terms covering training use, and independent corroboration.
